summary: Iteration 12 — Cases 18-24 tested. 10/10 backend pytest pass. All required data-testids present in frontend and working (dashboard-date-filter/from/to/clear, followup-time-input, duplicate-badge, lead-dup-{id}, attachment-view/viewer/close, break-report-allstatus-toggle, wa-msg-status render code path). Case 22 UI viewer flow verified via API path + testids present; Case 23 UI status labels code path exists (migrated Odoo messages lack a `status` field so 0 labels currently render in preview, which is data-driven not a bug).

minor.issue: Returns 503 'WhatsApp not configured' in preview because app_secret unset — expected per context. Once creds are entered the statuses branch (wa_cloud.py L47-63) correctly parses statuses, updates wa_messages.status/status_at/error and pushes status_history, and returns {status:'ok', status_updates:N}.

Soft-delete only. TEST_iter12_dup_A/B and TEST_iter12_att leads remain visible in list under Active filter after /lost — verify that mark-lost actually sets active=false (badge test still worked because they appear in list). Not blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: verify `POST /api/leads/{id}/lost` actually sets active=false — TEST_iter12 leads still visible in Active list post-cleanup (may need investigation; could be soft-delete flag not filtering).

OPTIONAL: since migrated Odoo WhatsApp messages lack a `status` field, wa-msg-status labels only appear on new outbound sends. If you want a nicer legacy render, treat NULL status on outbound as 'Sent' in WhatsAppInbox.jsx.

OPTIONAL: 'In range: X leads' text on the Dashboard was not detected in the outer DOM on default load — worth confirming it renders only when hasRange=true (intended per Dashboard.jsx). The clear button toggling was verified.
critical_code_review_comments: reports.py dashboard(): correct — has_range=false keeps by_stage on all-time `base`; only by_stage/leaderboard/top_tags/by_day scope to range when has_range. Matches requirement.
leads.py POST /leads: dup flag computed via check_duplicate(phone_digits) with proper exclude on self; is_duplicate + duplicate_of persisted; also logs '⚠️ Possible duplicate' — good UX.
leads.py LIST_PROJECTION and LeadCreate BOTH include follow_up_time; EDITABLE_FIELDS also includes it — end-to-end wired.
wa_cloud.py webhook: iterates value.get('statuses', []) and value.get('messages', []) independently — a statuses-only payload correctly produces status_updates>=1 without touching messages. Correct.
agent.py /status-logs supports breaks_only bool filter; each row has start/end/duration_sec — matches Case 24 spec.

LeadDetail.jsx: attachment-view eye button, attachment-viewer modal with URL.revokeObjectURL on close (good — no memory leak), followup-time-input, duplicate-badge with navigate to duplicate_of — all wired.
Leads.jsx lead-dup-{id} amber badge visible in list — verified visually in leads page.

Minor: check_duplicate does NOT filter active=true — a soft-deleted (lost) lead with same phone still flags a new one as duplicate. Debatable whether this is desired (finding history vs. only-open dups). Consider adding {active: True} to the duplicate lookup in core/utils.py to reduce false positives from legacy/lost leads.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required data-testids present, C18/C19/C20/C24 fully verified via UI; C22 upload flow via API works and UI selectors present; C23 UI status label code path exists — no legacy statuses to render in preview)
